*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,json,css,scss,md}: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = process.argv[1]; try { const content = fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8'); if (content.includes('\r\n')) { console.error('❌ File ' + path + ' contains CRLF line endings. Please convert to LF.'); process.exit(1); } } catch(e) { console.error('Error checking file:', e.message); process.exit(1); }"
